name: How does a commercial project manager ensure quality in luxury home construction?

mainEntity.name: How does a commercial project manager ensure quality in luxury home construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: A commercial project manager ensures quality through rigorous oversight and adherence to established standards. This includes meticulous selection of skilled craftsmen and reputable suppliers, regular site inspections, and implementation of quality control protocols at every stage of construction. They also verify that all work complies with design specifications, building codes, and the client's expectations for a luxury finish, proactively addressing any deviations to maintain the highest quality standards.
acceptedAnswer.description: Quality is ensured through meticulous contractor selection, regular site inspections, strict quality control protocols, and adherence to design specifications and building codes.
